**Shanghai/Capella Community Call**

On Jan 20, at 15UTC, we'll have a first Shanghai/Capella community call. We'll discuss the scope of the upgrade, important information related to withdrawals, and have Q&A for developers and infrastructure providers who'd like to better understand the upgrade. 

Call info here: https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/708
